name: curved-carousel
title: Curved Carousel
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A continuously scrolling carousel whose cards follow a curved arc path. Use it for logo walls and showcase strips that should feel ambient.
docs: Named exports: CurvedCarousel, CurvedCarouselCard. `speed` sets the drift rate and `autoPlay` toggles motion. Loops continuously rather than paging, so it suits decorative rows more than navigable content.
